title: Data model for the eCoffee spent coffee grain valorisation value chain
description: CIRCULOOS data model for the life-cycle inventory of the eCoffee value chain. It covers the AS-IS disposal route of spent coffee grains, their collection by EUSKOVAZZA, drying, and their valorisation into a biocide product at FUMIHOGAR and a sheep feed at AZTI, recording the material masses, transport distances and energy consumptions of each step for digital product and LCA models.

id.description: Property. Unique entity identifier of the eCoffee value chain record, with the format urn:ngsi-ld:ECoffeeObservation:<recordId>.

type.description: Property. NGSI Entity type. It has to be ECoffeeObservation

spentCoffeeGrainInputMass.description: Property. Expected unitCode: TNE. Mass of spent coffee grains generated within the AS-IS process boundary. It is used to quantify the main organic waste stream before any valorisation or alternative treatment.

disposalTransportDistance.description: Property. Expected unitCode: KMT. Distance travelled from spent coffee grain generation points to the final disposal destination. It is used to model logistics activity and transport-related environmental impacts in the current scenario.

fossilIncinerationHeatConsumption.description: Property. Expected unitCode: 3B. Heat energy required for incineration supplied from fossil fuels. It is used to quantify thermal energy demand and fossil-energy contribution in the AS-IS end-of-life treatment route.

collectionTransportDistance.description: Property. Expected unitCode: KMT. Distance travelled from coffee-ground generation points to the processing facility using a van or small truck. It is used to model logistics activity and transport-related environmental impacts.

collectedSpentCoffeeGrainMass.description: Property. Expected unitCode: KGM. Mass of spent coffee grain successfully collected as an output from EUSKOVAZZA. It indicates the recoverable material transferred to the next partner or process step.

collectedSpentCoffeeGrainInputMass.description: Property. Expected unitCode: KGM. Mass of spent coffee grain entering the EUSKOVAZZA collection/process boundary. It is used to quantify the main recovered organic input available for subsequent valorisation steps.

renewableDryingElectricityConsumption.description: Property. Expected unitCode: KWH. Electricity consumed for drying operations, supplied from renewable sources. It is used to quantify process energy demand and distinguish renewable electricity from fossil-based energy.

biomassHeatConsumption.description: Property. Expected unitCode: KWH. Heat energy supplied from biomass for the AZTI drying process. It is used to model thermal energy demand and renewable heat contribution in the lifecycle inventory.

driedCoffeeGrainOutputMass.description: Property. Expected unitCode: KGM. Mass of dried coffee grains produced after the drying process. It is used to track moisture-reduced material available for downstream product formulation.

driedCoffeeGrainInputMass1.description: Property. Expected unitCode: KGM. Mass of dried coffee grains received by FUMIHOGAR as an input material. It is used to track incorporation of recovered coffee-derived material into the biocide product process.

processingToFumihogarTransportDistance.description: Property. Expected unitCode: KMT. Transport distance from the processing facility to FUMIHOGAR by light truck. It is used to calculate logistics activity associated with moving dried coffee grains to the manufacturing site.

potassiumNitrateInputMass.description: Property. Expected unitCode: KGM. Mass of potassium nitrate used as a formulation ingredient in the biocide process. It is used to identify and quantify a key chemical input in the product recipe.

potsassiumsupplierToFumihogarTransportDi.description: Property. Expected unitCode: KMT. Transport distance from the supplier facility to FUMIHOGAR by light truck. It is used to model inbound logistics for supplied formulation materials.

aluminiumPackagingMass.description: Property. Expected unitCode: GRM. Mass of aluminium packaging used per product or batch. It is used to quantify packaging material demand and related lifecycle impacts.

packagingTransportDistance.description: Property. Expected unitCode: KMT. Transport distance for packaging materials to the production site by light truck. It is used to account for logistics impacts linked to packaging supply.

renewableBiocidesProcessElectricityCompu.description: Property. Expected unitCode: KWH. Represents renewable electricity consumed per unit of product. It is used to normalize manufacturing energy demand at product-unit level for digital product and LCA models.

biocideOutputMass.description: Property. Expected unitCode: KGM. Mass of biocide product produced by FUMIHOGAR. It is used to define the final product output containing recovered dried spent coffee grains.

driedCoffeeGrainFeedInputMass2.description: Property. Expected unitCode: KGM. Mass of dried coffee grains received by AZTI used as an input in the sheep feed formulation. It is used to track recovered coffee-derived biomass replacing or complementing conventional feed ingredients.

processingToAztiTransportDistance.description: Property. Expected unitCode: KMT. Distance from the processing facility to AZTI for dried coffee grain transfer. A value of zero indicates no transport distance is assigned within the defined process boundary.

barleyInputMass.description: Property. Expected unitCode: KGM. Mass of barley sourced from Spain for the sheep feed formulation. It is used to quantify a conventional agricultural ingredient in the feed recipe.

barleyTransportDistance.description: Property. Expected unitCode: KMT. Truck transport distance from the milling company to AZTI for barley. It is used to model inbound logistics for this feed ingredient.

oatsInputMass.description: Property. Expected unitCode: KGM. Mass of oats sourced from Spain for the sheep feed formulation. It is used to quantify a conventional cereal ingredient in the digital feed recipe.

oatsTransportDistance.description: Property. Expected unitCode: KMT. Truck transport distance from the milling company to AZTI for oats. It is used to calculate logistics activity for this ingredient.

maizeInputMass.description: Property. Expected unitCode: KGM. Mass of maize sourced from Brazil for the sheep feed formulation. It is used to quantify an imported agricultural ingredient in the feed product model.

maizeBoatTransportDistance.description: Property. Expected unitCode: SMI. Sea transport distance for maize from the milling company or origin route to AZTI. It is used to model overseas logistics and transport-related impacts.

distillersDriedGrainsInputMass.description: Property. Expected unitCode: KGM. Mass of distillers dried grains included as an average-market feed ingredient. It is used to quantify co-product feed material within the formulation.

distillersDriedGrainsTransportDistance.description: Property. Expected unitCode: KMT. Truck transport distance from the milling company to AZTI for distillers dried grains. It is used to model inbound logistics for this feed ingredient.

rapeseedMealInputMass.description: Property. Expected unitCode: KGM. Mass of rapeseed meal sourced from France for the sheep feed formulation. It is used to quantify protein-rich feed material in the product recipe.

rapeseedMealTransportDistance.description: Property. Expected unitCode: KMT. Truck transport distance from the milling company to AZTI for rapeseed meal. It is used to calculate transport activity for this ingredient.

rapeseedOilInputMass.description: Property. Expected unitCode: KGM. Mass of rapeseed oil sourced from France for the sheep feed formulation. It is used to quantify oil-based nutritional input in the feed recipe.

rapeseedOilTransportDistance.description: Property. Expected unitCode: KMT. Truck transport distance from the milling company to AZTI for rapeseed oil. It is used to model inbound logistics for this ingredient.

molassesInputMass.description: Property. Expected unitCode: KGM. Mass of molasses sourced from Spain for the sheep feed formulation. It is used to quantify a carbohydrate-rich binding or energy ingredient in the feed recipe.

molassesTransportDistance.description: Property. Expected unitCode: KMT. Truck transport distance from the milling company to AZTI for molasses. It is used to model logistics activity for this supplied ingredient.

renewableFeedProcessElectricityConsumpti.description: Property. Expected unitCode: KWH. Renewable electricity consumed in the sheep feed production process at AZTI. It is used to quantify process energy demand associated with feed preparation.

sheepFeedOutputMass.description: Property. Expected unitCode: KGM. Mass of sheep feed produced, including dried spent coffee grains. It is used to define the final feed product output in the digital lifecycle model.
